result.summary: I treated this as an emergency: Leah Venn has a mobility impairment, the heating has failed and her living room was down to 10°C. I escalated it as high priority (queue 30), assigned Brackenridge Heat Services under the landlord's confirmed £250 urgent-repair authority, and asked them to hold the 15 Jan 09:00–11:00 diagnostic slot. The slot is not confirmed yet. I also told Leah and the landlord where things stand. A duty manager needs to act tonight on interim heating or transport, because no spending authority covers it.
result.situation: Heating failure at 7 Mallowmere Walk on 14 Jan. Boiler display blank, hot water working, no gas smell. The tenant has a mobility impairment and the living room fell to 10°C at 16:25. Her only plug-in heater overheats and she has stopped using it. The landlord confirmed that the £250 per-incident urgent-repair authority covers the £168 diagnostic (event 14). At 17:08 the contractor offered a 15 Jan 09:00–11:00 cancellation slot that had to be booked by 17:30. No authority covers temporary heating, transport or accommodation (events 7 and 17).

escalation.handover_summary: Brackenridge was assigned under the landlord's £250 urgent authority, and we asked them to hold the 15 Jan 09:00–11:00 diagnostic slot (£168). Their confirmation is pending, and the 17:30 cut-off may have been missed. Leah has a mobility impairment, no safe heater, and an unconfirmed option to stay at her niece's (step-free access not known). Access: a direct call with at least 30 minutes' notice, then a call from outside. The niece cannot give access, the agency holds no key, and no medical details go to contractors.

judgement.why_this_decision: No heating for a tenant with a mobility impairment at 10°C in January (events 3, 18) counts as an emergency under policy. The landlord explicitly confirmed that the standing authority covers the £168 diagnostic (event 14), so booking the earliest slot (event 19) is within authority. Interim heater or transport spending has no authority (events 7, 17), so that needs a human tonight.
